research_question: Can a short-horizon forecaster improve temporal robustness by causally learning from only matured prior errors, using exponential forgetting and state-local residual correction, while preserving heterogeneous information blocks and legacy engine roles?

variants.STATIC: Exact V1.63-style rolling parent with equal training weight.
variants.FORGET: Same parent with exponentially decaying sample weights.
variants.ERRMEM: FORGET raw probability plus a shrunken causal residual-bias correction from matured prior forecast errors.
variants.LOCAL_ERRMEM: FORGET raw probability plus a shrunken residual correction weighted by recency and similarity of a compact current-state vector to matured prior origins.

state_local.scaling: prior-only mean/std from matured error-memory origins
state_local.missing: prior-only median fill; zero only if a column has no finite prior support
state_local.bandwidth: median positive prior-only state distance; fallback 1.0

interpretation_lock.purpose: Test causal self-correction and temporal robustness inside the forecaster, not model selection.
interpretation_lock.legacy_engines: Context only; never flat direction votes.
interpretation_lock.if_all_variants_fail: Do not weaken the frozen gate or retune V1.64 after observing results; open a new hypothesis/version.
interpretation_lock.if_any_variant_passes: Require a future prospective shadow before any production or trading claim.
